blurb: Forward Stride offers inclusive and accessible equine-assisted programs including psychotherapy, physical therapy, leadership, and vaulting. Programs are designed to empower individuals by using the healing power of horses to create lasting confidence, skills, and joy. Services include rehabilitation therapies and equine-assisted psychotherapy with licensed professionals.
